```{r}
#' MarTransfo_TS_exts_Mixture
#'
#' @param type_donnees 
#' @param coeurs 
#' @param lien_racine 
#' @param list_names
#' @param n.dens 
#' @param opt_Frech 
#' @param type_entree 
#'
#' @return
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
MarTransfo_TS_exts_Mixture<-function(type_donnees,coeurs,lien_racine,
                                     list_names,n.dens,
                                     opt_Frech,type_entree,
                                     Nb_Threshs,CPU_hearts){
  p_U<-list()
  l_Orig<-list()
  j<-1
  l_AD<-list()
  l_Kdens<-list()
  l_ev_theta<-list()
  d<-length(list_names)
  l_Transf<-list()
  for(name_variable in list_names){
    ### Add d to prevent contamination problems.
    lien_donnees<-paste0(lien_racine,name_variable,"_residuals_",
                         d,".csv")
    if(type_entree=="clust"){
      All<-read.csv(file=lien_donnees)
      colnames(All)<-c(1:38)
      Vrais_indices<-All[,38]
      Data<-All[,c(1:37)]
    }
    else{
      Data<-read.csv(file=lien_donnees)
    }
    l_Orig[[name_variable]]<-Data
    
    ### Choice of threshold using metric
    #######
    ### Here, we focus on positive exceedances
    SUM_pos<-apply(Data>0,MARGIN = 1,FUN = sum)
    IND_posj<-which(SUM_pos==ncol(Data))
    Data_pos<-Data[IND_posj,]
    Proba_pos<-apply(X = Data,MARGIN = 2,
                     FUN = function(x){
                       return(mean(as.numeric(x>0)))
                     })
    p_U_variable<-Choice_automatic_thresh_per_variable(df = Data_pos,
                    nb_threshs = Nb_Threshs,Qmin=0, 
                    Qmax = 0.95,hearts=CPU_hearts)
    ### Obtain actual
    p_uOpt<-sapply(c(1:ncol(Data)),
              function(k){
                pu_k<-p_U_variable[[k]][["p_u_opt"]]
                proba_posk<-Proba_pos[k]
                proba_pop_pos<-proba_posk*pu_k
                proba_pop_other<-(1-proba_posk)
                cplmt_pu<-proba_pop_pos+proba_pop_other
                ### p_U= weight put on the tail in Opitz.
                return(1-cplmt_pu)
                })

    p_U[[name_variable]]<-p_uOpt
    Vecteur_DIM<-c(1:ncol(Data))
    ### Own code
    Resultat_P<-as.data.frame(t(sapply(Vecteur_DIM,
                  f_marginales_all_Pareto,data_to_tf=Data,
                     p_u=p_uOpt,
                    n.dens=n.dens)))
    PARETO<-Resultat_P$obs
    ### Unit Pareto
    Vtransf<-do.call(cbind.data.frame,PARETO)
    Vunif<-(1-(1/Vtransf))
    if(opt_Frech==TRUE){
      ### Frechet(1)
      Vtransf<--1/log(Vunif)
    }else{
      ### GPD(sig=1,gam=1,u=0)
      Vtransf<-(1/(1-Vunif))-1
    }
   
    colnames(Vtransf)<-substr(colnames(Data),
                              start = 2,stop = 3)
    Times_found<-colnames(Vtransf)
    Intermed_list<-list("gamma"=Resultat_P$gamma,
                       "scale"=Resultat_P$scale,
                       "threshold"=Resultat_P$threshold,
                       "p_u"=Resultat_P$p_u,
                       "time_analysed"=Times_found)
    Df_theta<-data.frame(lapply(Intermed_list,
                                        FUN = unlist))
    rownames(Df_theta)<-c(1:nrow(Df_theta))
    l_ev_theta[[name_variable]]<-Df_theta
    
    ### Kdens export
    KDENS<-Resultat_P$kernel_dens
    L<-length(Times_found)
    LK<-lapply(c(1:L),function(t){
      var_x<-KDENS[[t]]
      Intermed_df<-data.frame(var_x$x,var_x$y)
      colnames(Intermed_df)<-c("x","y")
      Nt<-nrow(Intermed_df)
      ### Keep in memory the corresponding time step.
      real_time<-Times_found[t]
      Intermed_df$time_analysed<-rep(real_time,Nt)
      return(Intermed_df)
    })
    l_Kdens[[name_variable]]<-do.call(rbind.data.frame,
                                      LK)
    
    if(name_variable==list_names[1]){
      df<-matrix(NA,ncol=length(list_names),
                 nrow=nrow(Vtransf))
    }
    df[,j]<-apply(X = Vtransf,MARGIN = 1,FUN = calcul_norm_L2)
    j<-j+1
    l_Transf[[name_variable]]<-Vtransf
  }
  # Pareto ------------------------------------------------------------------
  return(list("df"=df,
          "evt_theta"=l_ev_theta,
          "k_dens"=l_Kdens,
          "Transf"=l_Transf))
}
```


```{r}
### Mixture model results
NB_THRESH<-20
Result_MV<-MarTransfo_TS_exts_Mixture(type_donnees = "hiver",
                   coeurs = coeurs,
                   lien_racine = l_root,
                   list_names = l_name,
                   n.dens = 2^(14),opt_Frech = opt_Frech,
                   type_entree = TE,
                   Nb_Threshs = NB_THRESH,
                   CPU_hearts = coeurs)


```


```{r}
Transf_all<-Result_MV$Transf
K_all<-Result_MV$k_dens
### Mixture
#######
for(nameV in l_name){
  d<-length(l_name)
  PARAMS_GPD<-Result_MV$evt_theta[[nameV]]
  Transf<-Transf_all[[nameV]]
  write.csv(file = paste0(path_conversion,nameV,
                          "_Mixt_transf_",d,
                          ".csv"),
            x =Transf,
            row.names = FALSE)

  #### GPD
  write.csv(file = paste0(path_conversion,nameV,"_GPD_params_",
                          d,".csv"),
            x = PARAMS_GPD,row.names = FALSE)
  ### Kdens
  K_fcg<-K_all[[nameV]]
  write.csv(file = paste0(path_conversion,nameV,"_Kdens_estim_",
                          d,".csv"),
            x = K_fcg,row.names = FALSE)
}
```
